protocol.telemetry_payload: SID32 epoch32 sample16 rangeMm16 age16 flagsMode16

acceptance.requirement: Default optional ADAS permits fresh user motor operation with only PC/SLM+Main; no SPI and no ADAS must not stop the motor solely for missing optional peers.
Fresh policy bypass plus fresh STOP barrier permits optional auxiliaries with ADAS flags 21 and physical ADAS LOW. Boot before policy or fresh STOP produces no output.
Fresh valid range 20..4000 mm activates ADAS; <=200 mm globally stops motor and auxiliary immediately. 100,199,200,250,4000 mm boundaries are explicit.
Every active/bypass policy transition forces outputs OFF, cancels old commands and requires a fresh user command. Disconnect/reconnect while moving cannot automatically resume.
REQUIRE_ADAS_FOR_MOTION=true preserves fail-closed without ADAS; default false bypass accepts supported motor operation.
Wrong SID, old epoch, policy replay, old telemetry sample, malformed payload and stale age cannot create fresh safety authority or revive commands.
Unknown NL, conflicts and wiper reject the entire plan. Supported unavailable optional outputs are SKIPPED with capability flags and do not falsely claim confirmed physical OFF.
Global STOP acts locally immediately regardless of peer connectivity and reaches connected remote peers. Watchdog, SID and epoch safety remain effective.
Decode LCD bus output to verify fresh distances 100/199/200/250/4000 mm, ERR, N/A and stale statuses; distance formatting fits the LCD and never silently displays old distance as fresh.
Motor and auxiliary physical register gates honor active ADAS physical LOW immediately; bypass permits operation despite physical ADAS LOW only after valid policy and STOP barrier.
All four Uno firmware targets compile; extracted distribution ZIP matches frozen source hashes and also builds. Source revision and hashes are reported.

limits.hardware: No flashing, hardware, serial or GitHub actions; physical root cause remains unknown.
limits.method: Exercise production engine paths and AVR register ISR paths using fake shims; do not implement a duplicate policy simulator.
